limitations: Binary alphabet and compulsory one-linear-run windows only; cyclic rather than linear covering, with rotations identified but reversals distinct. No generalization to multiple runs or arbitrary forbidden patterns. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
scientific_integrity: The unrestricted lower bound follows from mandatory-edge degree imbalance in the full binary de Bruijn graph. Matching augmentation constructs every circular-one-run window exactly once. The BEST theorem and an explicit inward-tree census count all optimum rotation classes. Computational checks are corroborative, not proofs of the all-length claims.
title: Optimal cyclic coverage of binary one-run windows: forced completion and exact multiplicity
